text: A trained model in a notebook helps nobody. This video plans how the churn score actually reaches Tom Bellamy's team.
The central decision: batch, not real-time. A weekly Azure ML Batch Endpoint job, not an always-on scoring API.
Why: Tom's team reviews renewal risk in a recurring weekly meeting. Nothing in that workflow needs a score refreshed by the minute.
Each weekly run scores every active account and writes AccountId, score, and risk tier into a new table -- dbo.ChurnRiskScores.
Tom's team reads it two ways: a dashboard for the weekly review, or direct SQL for one-off questions. Next: the first real extraction code against EVERPEAK_PROD.
